positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
NLP and Computational Social Science Lab:
•	Execute topic modeling analysis with Latent Dirichlet Allocation on wide range of data from online forums
•	Compiling and organizing data from topic and language analysis to develop a report on the role of online communities in parenting

FIDO Lab:
•	Research the spatial reasoning of dogs in maze navigation
•	Develop an interactive Arduino-based robot and new sensors for animal computer interaction
•	Conduct user testing with canine test subjects to evaluate robot functionality and compatibility with canines

positions.title: President
positions.description:
Directed the board of trustees to promote philanthropy and provide resources for scholarship in the UC San Diego student body through outreach, campaigns, and networking events.
Worked with the UC San Diego Foundation and Alumni Board to increase awareness of the need for student scholarships and secured donations from alumni and board members to support the scholarship fund.

positions.title: VP of Development
positions.description:
Head of donor recruitment efforts in raising money for student scholarships at the University of California, San Diego.
Organized and executed recruitment and networking events for current and potential student donors.
Developed campaigns for increased outreach on the university campus.

positions.title: Instructional Assistant
positions.description:
Assisted in teaching Research Methods for Cognitive Science.
Designed and taught a weekly class section of 30 students.

positions.title: Basic Writing Program Mentor
positions.description:
Mentored Basic Writing program students on a weekly basic to help improve their writing skills.
Strengthened students' understanding of college level writing practices and reading comprehension.
Explored and identified best practices for advanced writing and editing.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
Assisted the Director of Electronics in organizing project materials and the billing of equipment.
Worked alongside electronics technicians to provide support for research scientists at SLAC.
